purpose: Create scalable SEO landing pages for industrial panel, roofing, cladding, waterproofing, and engineering-control keywords.

global_rules.positioning: Every SEO page must position SIPANEL as an engineering-first industrial envelope systems company, not a generic supplier.
content_rules: One primary keyword per page.
Do not create thin SEO content.
Do not keyword-stuff.
Explain technical value clearly.
Connect every topic to risk reduction, leakage prevention, material optimization, or controlled execution.
Include internal links to services, case studies, resources, and RFQ.
Use real proof only.
Do not invent case studies or metrics.

quality_rules: Minimum 900 words equivalent for full SEO page when content is available.
Use short paragraphs and technical cards instead of dense text.
Every section must answer search intent.
Avoid repetitive generic content across pages.
Each page must include a unique angle, unique examples, and relevant CTAs.

content_rules: H1 must include the primary keyword naturally.
Intro must mention SIPANEL engineering control within the first 100 words.
CTA must be visible above fold on mobile.
Hero visual should be technical, industrial, and relevant to the keyword.

sections.purpose: Explain why the search topic matters in industrial projects.
content_rules: Connect the keyword to a real industrial problem.
Mention cost, leakage, delay, waste, coordination, or performance risk when relevant.
Avoid generic marketing language.

sections.purpose: Educate the visitor with technical clarity.
content_rules: Explain system logic in plain technical language.
Use diagrams or visual callouts before long explanation.
Avoid jargon unless explained.

required_solution_pillars.title: Precise Design
required_solution_pillars.description: Review system requirements, layout, details, and execution conditions before procurement.

required_solution_pillars.title: Smart Procurement
required_solution_pillars.description: Plan materials, accessories, quantities, flashings, and project needs to reduce waste and delays.

required_solution_pillars.title: Engineered Installation
required_solution_pillars.description: Execute with technical sequencing, inspection checkpoints, and controlled installation logic.

sections.title: Technical Proof Before Execution
rules: Use real assets when available.
If assets are missing, show structured pending placeholders.
Do not fake technical drawings.
Enable fullscreen viewer and zoom.
Add alt text using the primary keyword naturally.

content_rules: List industrial applications relevant to the keyword.
Each application should include one technical consideration.
Link to related service pages when relevant.

rules: Use practical checkpoints.
Avoid vague quality claims.
Connect checkpoints to risk reduction.

sections.title: Related Project Proof
rules: Use related real projects only.
If no project exists, show pending proof state instead of fake case studies.
Each card must include challenge, engineering decision, and result when available.

sections.title: Related Engineering Resources
rules: Link to resource hub.
Use lead capture for downloadable resources.
Track resource clicks.
Minimum 4 questions.
Maximum 7 questions.
Questions should match real search intent.
Answers must be clear, technical, and non-promotional.
At least one FAQ should connect to consultation or project review naturally.

sections.text_pattern: SIPANEL can review your project conditions, technical details, procurement needs, and installation risks before site execution.

Use educational content when case study proof is unavailable.
Keep CTA active even if proof assets are pending.

implementation_instruction_for_claude_co.task: Implement a reusable SEO landing page system based on this JSON specification.
rules: Create one reusable SEO landing page template powered by page data.
Create initial pages from recommended_landing_pages.
Generate localized routes for EN, FA, AR, RU.
Apply RTL layout for FA and AR.
Use next-intl for localized content.
Use generateMetadata for localized SEO metadata.
Add hreflang and canonical logic.
Add FAQ schema and BreadcrumbList schema.
Use real assets when available.
Do not invent metrics or case studies.
If data is missing, use pending proof states.
Do not ask approval for normal implementation decisions.
Ask only if verified project data, destructive commands, paid services, or conflicting specifications are involved.
